An official Southeast University repost reports that Vice President Jin Shi said the university built an AI-MUST curriculum system covering all majors and revised course syllabi to add AI literacy and technical-support objectives.

The 2026 Graduate School notice says AI-enabled graduate education application-scenario cases should show AI's value in graduate training and should follow AI-related usage norms to ensure safe application.

For AI+ graduate course project applications, the Graduate School notice says proposed course content must comply with national laws, policies, correct orientation requirements, confidentiality restrictions, and intellectual property requirements.

Southeast University's Graduate School opened 2026 school-level applications for AI-enabled graduate education projects in three categories: AI+ graduate courses, AI-enabled graduate teaching reform research projects, and AI-enabled graduate education application scenarios.
